name: Spaghetti pomodoro
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil for the spaghetti.
Peel and thinly slice the garlic cloves.
Warm the olive oil in a wide pan over low heat and fry the garlic for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant but not brown.
Add the canned tomatoes, crush them with a spoon, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 15 minutes until thickened.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in the boiling water until al dente, about 9 minutes, and keep a cup of the pasta water.
Drain the spaghetti and toss it in the sauce over medium heat for 1 minute, adding a splash of pasta water if it looks dry.
Tear the basil leaves into the pasta, grate the parmesan over it and serve straight away.

name: Spaghetti carbonara
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil for the spaghetti.
Cut the guanciale into small strips.
Finely grate the pecorino and whisk it with the eggs and plenty of black pepper in a bowl.
Fry the guanciale in a dry pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp and the fat has melted, then take the pan off the heat.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente, about 9 minutes, and keep a cup of the pasta water before draining.
Add the spaghetti to the guanciale and toss well so it is coated in the fat.
With the pan off the heat, pour in the egg mixture and toss quickly, adding pasta water a little at a time until the sauce is creamy, not scrambled.
Serve at once with more black pepper.

name: Pesto pasta with cherry tomatoes
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil for the penne.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until golden, then set them aside.
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Cook the penne until al dente, about 11 minutes, and keep a cup of the pasta water before draining.
Warm the olive oil in the pan over medium heat and fry the cherry tomatoes for 2 minutes until they just soften.
Add the penne and the pesto with a splash of pasta water and toss until glossy.
Serve sprinkled with the pine nuts and grated parmesan.

name: Lasagne
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot, celery stalk and garlic cloves.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and fry the chopped vegetables for 8 minutes until soft.
Turn up the heat, add the ground beef and fry for 5 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the tomato paste, pour in the red wine and let it bubble for 2 minutes.
Add the canned tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and simmer gently for 45 minutes, stirring now and then.
For the white sauce, melt the butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk in the milk a little at a time and simmer for 5 minutes, whisking, until thick, then season with the nutmeg and salt.
Heat the oven to 180 °C.
In a baking dish, layer meat sauce, lasagne sheets and white sauce, repeating until everything is used and finishing with white sauce.
Scatter the grated parmesan on top and bake for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling, then rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

name: Käsespätzle
steps: Mix the flour, eggs, milk, nutmeg and a pinch of salt and beat with a wooden spoon for a few minutes until the dough is smooth and bubbly.
Let the dough rest for 15 minutes while you bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Slice the onions into thin rings and fry them in the butter over medium heat for 15 minutes until golden brown.
Grate the emmental and heat the oven to 180 °C.
Press the dough through a spätzle maker or scrape it off a board into the boiling water in batches, and lift each batch out with a slotted spoon once it floats.
Layer the hot spätzle with the emmental in a baking dish, finishing with emmental.
Bake for 10 minutes until the emmental has melted.
Top with the fried onions and the chopped chives and serve.

name: Chili con carne
steps: Finely chop the onions and garlic cloves and dice the bell pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and fry the onions for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and bell pepper and fry for 3 minutes more.
Turn up the heat, add the ground beef and fry for 5 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, oregano and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the canned tomatoes and beef stock, season with salt and pepper and simmer gently for 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Drain and rinse the canned kidney beans, stir them in and simmer for 10 minutes more.

name: Goulash with bread
steps: Cut the beef into 3 cm cubes and pat them dry.
Chop the onions and finely chop the garlic cloves.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over high heat and brown the beef in batches, then set it aside.
Lower the heat to medium and fry the onions for 10 minutes until golden, then add the garlic cloves and tomato paste and fry for 1 minute more.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the paprika, caraway and marjoram so the paprika doesn't burn.
Put the pot back on the heat, return the beef, pour in the beef stock, season with salt and pepper and bring to the boil.
Cover and simmer gently for 1 hour 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until the beef is tender.
Serve the goulash with slices of bread.

name: Beef burgers with oven fries
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Cut the potatoes into 1 cm thick fries, toss them with the olive oil, paprika and salt and spread them out on the tray.
Bake the fries for 35 to 40 minutes, turning them halfway, until golden and crisp.
Meanwhile, slice the tomatoes and red onion, separate the lettuce leaves and slice the cheddar.
Shape the ground beef into 4 patties slightly wider than the burger buns and season them with salt and pepper.
Fry the patties in a hot pan over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, laying the cheddar on top after turning them.
Toast the cut sides of the burger buns in the pan for 1 minute.
Spread ketchup on the buns and build the burgers with lettuce, tomato, the patties and red onion, then serve with the fries.

name: Stuffed peppers
steps: Cook the rice in salted water for 10 minutes so it is half done, then drain it.
Heat the oven to 190 °C.
Cut the tops off the bell peppers and scoop out the seeds.
Finely chop the onion and garlic cloves and fry them in the olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the ground beef and fry for 5 minutes until browned, then stir in the paprika and half of the canned tomatoes and season with salt and pepper.
Mix the rice into the filling and stuff the bell peppers with it.
Pour the rest of the canned tomatoes into a baking dish, season them, stand the peppers in it and put their tops back on.
Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes.
Take off the foil and the tops, lay slices of mozzarella on the peppers and bake for 10 minutes more until melted and golden.

name: Schnitzel with potato salad
steps: Boil the unpeeled potatoes in salted water for 20 to 25 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, finely chop the onion.
Simmer the onion in the beef stock in a small pan for 2 minutes.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the white wine vinegar, mustard, 2 tbsp of the vegetable oil, salt and pepper.
Drain the potatoes, then peel and thinly slice them while still warm.
Pour the warm dressing over the potatoes, mix gently and leave them for 30 minutes to soak it up.
Pound the pork cutlets between cling film to about 5 mm thick and season them with salt and pepper.
Set out three plates: one with the flour, one with the eggs beaten with a pinch of salt, and one with the breadcrumbs.
Coat each cutlet in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, without pressing the crumbs on.
Heat the rest of the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and fry the schnitzels for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden, shaking the pan so the coating puffs up.
Drain the schnitzels on kitchen paper.
Stir the chopped chives into the potato salad and serve it with the schnitzels and lemon wedges.

name: Chicken curry with rice
steps: Finely chop the onions and garlic cloves and grate the ginger.
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat and fry the onions for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and fry for 5 minutes, turning it, until sealed all over.
Pour in the canned tomatoes and coconut milk, season with salt and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of salted water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Serve the curry over the rice.

name: Teriyaki chicken with rice
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Stir the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Pat the chicken thighs dry and slice the spring onions.
Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the chicken thighs for 6 to 8 minutes until golden, then turn and fry for 4 minutes more.
Wipe out the excess fat, pour in the sauce and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, turning the chicken, until the sauce is thick and glossy and the chicken is cooked through.
Slice the chicken, lay it on the rice and spoon the sauce over it.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and sesame seeds and serve.

name: Chicken fajitas
steps: Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and crush the garlic cloves.
Mix the chicken with the garlic, cumin, paprika, chili powder, the juice of the lime, 1 tbsp of the vegetable oil and salt.
Leave the chicken to marinate for 15 minutes.
Slice the bell peppers and red onion into thin strips.
Heat the rest of the vegetable oil in a large pan over high heat and fry the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until browned and cooked through, then set it aside.
Fry the bell peppers and red onion in the same pan over high heat for 5 minutes until soft and charred at the edges.
Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill the tortillas with the chicken and vegetables, top with sour cream, roll them up and serve.

name: Chicken Caesar salad
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut the bread into 2 cm cubes, toss them with 2 tbsp of the olive oil and bake for 8 to 10 minutes until golden and crisp.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper and fry it in 1 tbsp of the olive oil over medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes per side until cooked through, then let it rest for 5 minutes.
Boil the egg for 1 minute, cool it under cold water and spoon the soft egg into a bowl.
Mash the anchovy fillets and crushed garlic clove into the egg, then whisk in the worcestershire sauce, the juice of the lemon and the rest of the olive oil in a thin stream.
Grate the parmesan, stir half of it into the dressing and season with pepper.
Tear the romaine lettuce into pieces and toss it with the dressing.
Slice the chicken and serve it on the salad with the croutons and the rest of the parmesan.

name: Oven-baked salmon with potatoes and green beans
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut the potatoes into 3 cm pieces and toss them on a baking tray with half of the olive oil, the crushed garlic cloves, salt and pepper.
Roast the potatoes for 20 minutes.
Trim the green beans and slice one lemon.
Push the potatoes to the sides, add the green beans and the salmon, drizzle with the rest of the olive oil, season and lay the lemon slices on the salmon.
Roast for 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily and the potatoes are golden.
Squeeze the juice of the second lemon over everything, scatter the chopped dill on top and serve.

name: Fish tacos
steps: Finely shred the red cabbage and mix it with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt.
Cut the cod into strips and season it with the cumin, paprika, salt and pepper.
Halve and stone the avocados and slice the flesh.
Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium-high heat and fry the cod for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill the tortillas with the red cabbage, cod and avocado.
Top with sour cream and chopped coriander and serve with the second lime cut into wedges.

name: Chickpea and spinach curry
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of salted water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Finely chop the onion and garlic cloves and grate the ginger.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat and fry the onion for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Drain and rinse the canned chickpeas and add them with the canned tomatoes and coconut milk, then season with salt.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted, then serve the curry over the rice.

name: Vegetable stir-fry with noodles
steps: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes, then drain and rinse them under cold water.
Slice the bell pepper and carrot into thin strips, halve the snow peas and slice the spring onions.
Finely chop the garlic cloves and grate the ginger.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and snow peas and stir-fry for 2 minutes more.
Add the garlic, ginger and spring onions and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the egg noodles and soy sauce and toss for 2 minutes until hot.
Take the wok off the heat, drizzle with the sesame oil and serve.

name: Fried rice with egg and vegetables
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of salted water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Spread the rice on a plate, let it cool, then chill it in the fridge for at least 1 hour, or overnight, so it fries without clumping.
Dice the carrot, slice the spring onions and finely chop the garlic clove.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat, pour in the eggs and scramble them for 1 minute until just set, then push them to the side.
Add the carrot and garlic and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the cold rice and peas and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes, breaking up any clumps, until hot.
Stir in the soy sauce and spring onions and toss everything together with the eggs.
Take the wok off the heat, drizzle with the sesame oil and serve.

name: Ratatouille with rice
steps: Cut the eggplant, zucchini and bell peppers into 2 cm pieces.
Chop the onion, garlic cloves and tomatoes.
Heat half of the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and fry the eggplant for 5 minutes until golden, then set it aside.
Add the rest of the olive oil and fry the zucchini and bell peppers for 5 minutes, then set them aside too.
Fry the onion in the same pan over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic cloves and fry for 1 minute more.
Add the tomatoes, thyme and bay leaf and cook for 5 minutes until they start to break down.
Return all the vegetables, season with salt and pepper, cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of salted water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf, stir in the torn basil and serve the ratatouille with the rice.

name: Mushroom risotto
steps: Heat the vegetable stock in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer.
Finely chop the onion and garlic cloves, and slice the mushrooms.
Heat the olive oil in a wide pan and fry the mushrooms over high heat for 5 minutes until golden, then take them out and set them aside.
Lower the heat to medium and fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic cloves and fry for 1 minute more.
Add the arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes until the grains turn glossy.
Pour in the white wine and stir until it has been absorbed.
Add the hot stock one ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each ladle is absorbed, for about 18 minutes until the arborio rice is creamy and just tender.
Stir the mushrooms back in, take the pan off the heat and stir in the butter and the grated parmesan.
Season with salt and pepper, cover and let the risotto rest for 2 minutes before serving.

name: Shakshuka with bread
steps: Finely chop the onion and garlic cloves, and cut the bell pepper into strips.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan and fry the onion and bell pepper over medium heat for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the canned tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Make 4 hollows in the sauce with a spoon and crack an egg into each one.
Cover the pan and cook over low heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the egg whites are set but the yolks are still runny.
Crumble the feta over the top.
Slice the bread and serve it with the shakshuka for dipping.

name: Spinach and feta quiche
steps: Heat the oven to 190 °C and line a 24 cm tart tin with the shortcrust pastry, then prick the base all over with a fork.
Cover the pastry with baking paper weighed down with baking weights and bake for 15 minutes, then remove the paper and weights.
Finely chop the onion and garlic clove.
Put the spinach, onion and garlic in a large pan with a splash of water, cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes until the spinach has wilted and the onion is soft.
Let the spinach mixture cool, squeeze out as much liquid as you can and chop it roughly.
Whisk the eggs with the cream and nutmeg, and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the spinach mixture over the pastry case, crumble the feta on top and pour over the egg mixture.
Lower the oven to 180 °C and bake the quiche for 30 to 35 minutes until the filling is set and golden.
Let the quiche rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Baked potatoes with herb quark
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Scrub the potatoes, prick them all over with a fork and rub them with the olive oil and some salt.
Bake the potatoes directly on the oven rack for 60 minutes until the skins are crisp and a knife slides in easily.
Meanwhile finely chop the chives and parsley and crush the garlic clove.
Stir the quark with the milk until smooth, mix in the chives, parsley and garlic, and season with salt and pepper.
Cut a cross into the top of each potato, squeeze it open and fill it with the herb quark.

name: Couscous salad with halloumi
steps: Bring the vegetable stock to the boil, pour it over the couscous in a bowl, cover and leave it for 5 minutes.
Fluff up the couscous with a fork and let it cool.
Dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes and finely chop the red onion.
Finely chop the parsley and mint.
Whisk the juice of the lemon with 3 tbsp of the olive oil, salt and pepper.
Mix the couscous with the cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion, parsley, mint and dressing.
Slice the halloumi and fry it in the remaining olive oil over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Serve the salad topped with the warm halloumi.

name: Greek salad with feta and bread
steps: Cut the tomatoes into wedges and the cucumber into thick half-moons.
Slice the bell pepper into rings and the red onion into thin half-rings.
Put the vegetables in a bowl with the olives and season with salt.
Lay the feta on top as one slab and sprinkle it with the oregano.
Drizzle the olive oil over the salad.
Slice the bread and serve it with the salad to mop up the juices.

name: Lentil soup
steps: Finely chop the onion and garlic cloves, and dice the carrots.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot and fry the onion and carrots over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and tomato paste and fry for 1 minute.
Rinse the red lentils, add them to the pot with the vegetable stock and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils have broken down.
Blend the soup until smooth, adding a little water if it is too thick.
Squeeze in the juice of half the lemon, season with salt and pepper and serve with the rest of the lemon cut into wedges.

name: Minestrone
steps: Dice the onion, carrots, celery stalks, zucchini and potato, and chop the garlic cloves.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot and fry the onion, carrots and celery over medium heat for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, potato and zucchini and fry for 2 minutes.
Add the canned tomatoes and vegetable stock, bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
Drain and rinse the canned white beans, add them with the ditalini and simmer for 10 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Tear in the basil and season with salt and pepper.
Serve the soup with the parmesan grated over the top.

name: Pumpkin soup
steps: Peel the pumpkin, scrape out and discard the fibres and seeds, and cut it into cubes.
Chop the onion, garlic clove and ginger.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot and fry the onion over medium heat for 5 minutes, then add the garlic clove and ginger and fry for 1 minute more.
Add the pumpkin and vegetable stock, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes until the pumpkin is soft.
Meanwhile toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes until they start to pop.
Blend the soup until smooth, stir in the cream and nutmeg, and season with salt and pepper.
Reheat the soup gently and serve it sprinkled with the pumpkin seeds.

name: Tomato soup with grilled cheese
steps: Chop the onion and garlic cloves.
Heat the olive oil in a pot and fry the onion over medium heat for 5 minutes, then add the garlic cloves and fry for 1 minute more.
Add the canned tomatoes and vegetable stock, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the basil and blend the soup until smooth.
Stir in the cream, season with salt and pepper and keep the soup warm over low heat.
Grate the cheddar and spread the butter on one side of each slice of bread.
Make sandwiches with the cheddar between two slices, buttered sides facing out.
Fry the sandwiches in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and the cheddar has melted.
Cut the sandwiches in half and serve them with the hot soup.

name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot, celery stalk and garlic cloves.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan and fry the chopped vegetables over medium heat for 8 minutes until soft.
Turn up the heat, add the ground beef and fry for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Pour in the milk and simmer for about 10 minutes, until it has been absorbed.
Pour in the red wine and let it bubble for 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and canned tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and simmer gently with the lid half on for 1 hour, stirring now and then.
About 15 minutes before the sauce is done, cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted water until al dente, about 9 minutes.
Drain the spaghetti, toss it with the sauce and serve with the parmesan grated over the top.

name: Penne arrabbiata
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Thinly slice the garlic cloves and chop the parsley.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over low heat and fry the garlic and chili flakes for 2 minutes without letting the garlic brown.
Add the canned tomatoes, season with salt and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Meanwhile cook the penne in the boiling water until al dente, about 11 minutes.
Drain the penne, toss it in the sauce over the heat for 1 minute and stir in the parsley.

name: Spaghetti aglio e olio
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente, about 9 minutes.
Meanwhile thinly slice the garlic cloves and finely chop the parsley.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over low heat and fry the garlic and chili flakes for 3 to 4 minutes until the garlic turns pale golden.
Scoop out a cup of the pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
Add the spaghetti and a splash of the pasta water to the pan and toss over medium heat for 1 minute until the sauce turns glossy.
Stir in the parsley, season with salt and serve.

name: Mac and cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cook the macaroni in salted water for 2 minutes less than the packet says, then drain it.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until the sauce thickens.
Grate the cheddar, take the pan off the heat and stir in two thirds of it, then season with salt and pepper.
Mix the macaroni with the sauce and spread it in a baking dish.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the rest of the cheddar and the paprika and scatter them over the top.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Gnocchi with tomato sauce and mozzarella
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C and bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Chop the garlic cloves and fry them in the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the canned tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Tear half the basil into the sauce.
Cook the gnocchi in the boiling water until they float to the surface, then drain them.
Mix the gnocchi with the sauce and spread them in a baking dish.
Tear the mozzarella over the top and sprinkle with the grated parmesan.
Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until the mozzarella has melted and is bubbling.
Scatter the rest of the basil over the top and serve.

name: Spinach and ricotta cannelloni
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C.
Wilt the spinach in a large covered pan over medium heat for 3 minutes, let it cool, squeeze it dry and chop it.
Mix the spinach with the ricotta, egg and nutmeg, and season with salt and pepper.
Fill the cannelloni tubes with the spinach mixture using a small spoon or a piping bag.
Chop the garlic cloves and fry them in the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the canned tomatoes and torn basil, season with salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
For the white sauce, melt the butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick, then season with salt.
Spread the red sauce in a baking dish and lay the filled cannelloni tubes on top in a single layer.
Pour the white sauce over the cannelloni and sprinkle with the grated parmesan.
Bake for 35 minutes until the pasta is tender and the top is golden.

name: Pizza margherita
steps: Mix most of the flour, keeping back a handful for shaping, with the dry yeast and 1 tsp of salt in a bowl, then add 300 ml of lukewarm water and 2 tbsp of the olive oil.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Heat the oven to 250 °C with a baking tray inside.
Crush the canned tomatoes with the remaining olive oil and a pinch of salt to make a rough sauce.
Divide the dough into 4 pieces and stretch each one into a thin round on a surface dusted with the rest of the flour.
Spread the sauce over the bases, leaving a border, and top with torn mozzarella.
Bake each pizza on the hot tray for 8 to 10 minutes until the crust is golden and the mozzarella is bubbling.
Scatter the basil over the pizzas and serve.

name: Shepherd's pie
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them into chunks and boil them in salted water for 20 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile finely chop the onion and dice the carrots.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan and brown the ground lamb over high heat for 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the onion and carrots and fry over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef stock, worcestershire sauce and thyme and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Stir in the peas and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with the butter and milk, then season with salt and pepper.
Spoon the filling into a baking dish, spread the mash over it and rough up the top with a fork.
Bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden and the filling is bubbling.

name: Meatballs in tomato sauce with rice
steps: Finely chop the onion, garlic cloves and parsley.
Mix the ground beef with the breadcrumbs, egg, grated parmesan, parsley, half the garlic, salt and pepper.
Shape the mixture into balls about 3 cm across.
Heat 2 tbsp of the olive oil in a large pan and brown the meatballs over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, turning them, then set them aside.
Fry the onion and the rest of the garlic in the remaining olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the canned tomatoes, season with salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the meatballs to the sauce, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of salted water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Tear the basil over the meatballs and serve them with the rice.

name: Beef stroganoff with rice
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of salted water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile cut the beef sirloin into thin strips and slice the onion and mushrooms.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over high heat and sear the beef sirloin strips in batches for 1 to 2 minutes until browned, then set them aside.
Lower the heat to medium, melt the butter in the pan and fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the mushrooms and fry for 5 minutes until golden, then stir in the paprika.
Pour in the beef stock, stir in the mustard and simmer for 5 minutes until slightly reduced.
Lower the heat, stir in the sour cream and return the meat with its juices, then heat through gently for 2 minutes without boiling.
Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with the chopped parsley and serve with the rice.

name: Bratwurst with sauerkraut and mashed potatoes
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them into even chunks and boil them in salted water for 20 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile, heat half of the vegetable oil in a pot and fry the chopped onion over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the sauerkraut, bay leaf, caraway and a splash of water, then cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Heat the rest of the vegetable oil in a frying pan and fry the bratwurst over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, turning them until browned on all sides.
Warm the milk with the butter in a small pan until the butter melts.
Drain the potatoes, mash them and beat in the hot milk until smooth, then season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Remove the bay leaf from the sauerkraut and serve it with the bratwurst, the mashed potatoes and mustard on the side.

name: Sweet and sour pork with rice
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Cut the pork shoulder into 2 cm cubes, season with salt and toss them in the beaten egg.
Coat the pork cubes in most of the cornstarch, keeping 1 tbsp back for the sauce.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or deep pan to 180 °C and fry the pork in batches for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and crisp, then drain on kitchen paper.
Drain the canned pineapple, keeping the juice, and stir the juice with the ketchup, rice vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and the remaining cornstarch.
Pour off all but 1 tbsp of oil and stir-fry the onion and bell pepper pieces over high heat for 3 minutes, adding the sliced garlic cloves for the last minute.
Add the pineapple pieces and the sauce and stir for 1 to 2 minutes until it thickens and turns glossy.
Toss the fried pork in the sauce and serve it at once with the rice.

name: Chicken drumsticks with roasted vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Rub the chicken drumsticks with half of the olive oil, the paprika, the thyme, the grated zest of the lemon, salt and pepper.
Cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks and the red onions into wedges.
Toss the vegetables with the rest of the olive oil, salt and pepper and spread them on a baking tray.
Lay the chicken drumsticks on top of the vegetables and roast for 20 minutes.
Cut the bell peppers and zucchini into chunks and add them to the tray with the whole garlic cloves.
Turn the drumsticks and roast for another 25 minutes until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear.
Squeeze the juice of the lemon over the tray and serve.

name: Butter chicken with naan
steps: Grate the garlic cloves and the ginger.
Cut the chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces and mix them with the yogurt, the juice of the lemon, half of the garlic and ginger, 1 tsp of the garam masala, the chili powder and salt.
Cover the bowl and leave the chicken to marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan and sear the chicken over high heat for 5 to 6 minutes until charred at the edges, then set it aside.
Melt the butter in the same pan and fry the chopped onion over medium heat for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the rest of the garlic cloves and ginger, the cumin and the remaining garam masala and fry for 1 minute.
Add the canned tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes, then blend the sauce until smooth.
Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the cream and the dried fenugreek leaf, crumbled between your palms, and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Warm the naan in a hot dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes.
Sprinkle the curry with chopped coriander and serve it with the naan.

name: Chicken noodle soup
steps: Chop the onion, carrots and celery stalks and mince the garlic cloves.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot and cook the onion, carrots and celery stalks over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Add the chicken stock, the whole chicken thighs, the thyme and the bay leaf and bring to the boil.
Simmer gently for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken and remove the bay leaf.
Shred the chicken with two forks.
Add the egg noodles to the soup and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes until tender.
Return the shredded chicken, season with salt and pepper and stir in the chopped parsley before serving.

name: Chicken quesadillas
steps: Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and season it with the cumin, chili powder and salt.
Heat the vegetable oil in a frying pan and fry the chicken over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Add the sliced bell pepper and red onion and fry for 3 minutes more, then tip everything onto a plate and wipe out the pan.
Sprinkle half of each tortilla with half of the grated cheddar.
Spread the chicken mixture and chopped coriander over the cheddar and cover them with the rest of the cheddar.
Fold each tortilla over the filling.
Cook the quesadillas in the dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheddar has melted.
Cut them into wedges and serve with sour cream.

name: Pad thai with chicken
steps: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for 20 to 30 minutes until soft but still firm, then drain.
Stir the tamarind paste, fish sauce, sugar and chili flakes together until the sugar dissolves.
Roughly chop the peanuts, slice the spring onions and cut the lime into wedges.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the thinly sliced chicken breast for 3 to 4 minutes, adding the minced garlic cloves for the last 30 seconds.
Push the chicken to the side, crack the eggs into the wok and scramble them for 1 minute.
Add the drained noodles and the sauce and toss for 2 to 3 minutes until the noodles have soaked up the sauce.
Toss in the bean sprouts and spring onions for 30 seconds.
Serve sprinkled with the peanuts, with the lime wedges on the side.

name: Fish and chips
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them into thick chips, rinse them in cold water and pat them dry.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep pan to 140 °C and fry the chips in batches for 6 to 8 minutes until soft but still pale, then drain.
Whisk most of the flour with the baking powder and a pinch of salt, then whisk in the cold beer to a smooth, thick batter.
Cut the cod into 4 pieces, pat them dry, season with salt and dust them in the remaining flour.
Heat the vegetable oil to 180 °C.
Dip the cod in the batter and fry it for 5 to 7 minutes until golden and crisp, then drain it on kitchen paper and keep it warm.
Fry the chips again at 180 °C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and crisp, then drain and salt them.
Serve the fish and chips with wedges of lemon.

name: Tuna pasta bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cook the penne in salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the packet says, then drain.
Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until the sauce thickens.
Take the sauce off the heat and stir in half of the grated cheddar, salt and pepper.
Mix the penne with the sauce, the drained canned tuna and the drained canned sweetcorn and spread it in a baking dish.
Sprinkle with the rest of the cheddar and bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Seafood paella
steps: Scrub the mussels and discard any that stay open when tapped.
Cut the squid into rings.
Heat the fish stock with the saffron and keep it hot.
Heat the olive oil in a paella pan and sear the prawns and squid over high heat for 2 minutes, then set them aside.
Fry the chopped onion, bell pepper and garlic cloves in the pan over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the grated tomatoes and the paprika and cook for 5 minutes until thick.
Stir in the paella rice to coat it, then pour in the hot stock, season with salt and simmer without stirring for 10 minutes.
Arrange the prawns, squid, mussels and peas on top of the paella rice.
Cook for 8 to 10 minutes more without stirring, until the paella rice is tender, the stock is absorbed and the mussels have opened.
Take the pan off the heat, cover it with a clean towel and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Discard any mussels that have not opened.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve with wedges of lemon.

name: Thai green curry with prawns
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Tear each makrut lime leaf in half.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok and fry the green curry paste over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add a third of the coconut milk and cook for 3 minutes until the oil starts to separate.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, the fish sauce, the sugar and the torn leaves, and bring to a simmer.
Add the eggplant, cut into chunks, and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the green beans, cut into short lengths, and simmer for 4 minutes.
Add the prawns and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until they are pink and cooked through.
Stir in the thai basil leaves and serve the curry with the rice.

name: Falafel wraps with hummus
steps: The day before, soak the dried chickpeas in plenty of cold water for at least 12 hours.
Drain the chickpeas well and blitz them in a food processor with the onion, garlic cloves, parsley, coriander, cumin and salt to a coarse paste.
Stir in the baking powder and flour and chill the mixture for 30 minutes.
Shape the mixture into walnut-sized balls.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep pan to 175 °C and fry the falafel in batches for 3 to 4 minutes until deep brown, then drain on kitchen paper.
Slice the tomatoes and cucumber and shred the lettuce.
Warm each flatbread in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Spread each flatbread with hummus, add the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber and falafel, and roll it up.

name: Bean burritos
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of salted water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a pan and fry the chopped onion over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the minced garlic cloves, cumin and chili powder and fry for 1 minute.
Add the drained canned pinto beans with a splash of water, roughly mash them and simmer for 5 minutes, then season with salt.
Dice the tomatoes and mix them with chopped coriander, the juice of the lime and salt.
Warm each tortilla in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill the tortillas with rice, beans, grated cheddar, the tomato salsa and sour cream, fold in the sides and roll them up.

name: Eggplant parmigiana
steps: Cut the eggplants lengthwise into 1 cm slices.
Sprinkle the slices with salt and leave them for 30 minutes.
Pat the eggplant slices dry with kitchen paper.
Heat the vegetable oil in a frying pan and fry the eggplant slices in batches over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden, then drain on kitchen paper.
Heat the olive oil in a pan and fry the sliced garlic cloves for 1 minute.
Add the canned tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes until thick, then season and tear in half of the basil.
Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Layer the sauce, eggplant slices, sliced mozzarella, grated parmesan and basil leaves in a baking dish, repeating until everything is used and ending with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake for 30 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Spanish tortilla with salad
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them into thin slices and thinly slice the onion.
Heat most of the olive oil in a 24 cm frying pan and cook the potatoes and onion over medium-low heat for 20 minutes, turning them now and then, until soft but not browned.
Drain the potatoes and onion in a sieve, keeping the oil.
Beat the eggs with salt, stir in the potatoes and onion and leave for 10 minutes.
Heat 2 tbsp of the drained oil in the pan, pour in the mixture and cook over medium-low heat for 6 minutes until the bottom is set.
Put a plate over the pan, turn the omelette out onto it and slide it back into the pan.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes more until just set.
Tear the lettuce and cut the tomatoes into wedges.
Dress the lettuce and tomatoes with the rest of the olive oil, the white wine vinegar, salt and pepper.
Cut the potato omelette into wedges and serve with the salad.

name: Potato and leek soup
steps: Slice the leeks, wash them well and chop the onion.
Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the leeks and onion over low heat for 10 minutes until soft but not browned.
Add the peeled and diced potatoes and the vegetable stock, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are soft.
Blend the soup until smooth.
Stir in the cream, season with salt and pepper and heat through without boiling.
Serve sprinkled with chopped chives.

name: French onion soup
steps: Thinly slice the onions.
Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the onions over medium-low heat for 40 to 50 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden brown.
Stir in the flour and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the white wine and let it bubble for 2 minutes, scraping the bottom of the pot.
Add the beef stock, thyme and bay leaf and simmer for 20 minutes, then remove the bay leaf and season.
Heat the oven grill to high.
Slice the bread and toast it under the grill for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden.
Ladle the soup into ovenproof bowls, top with the toasted bread and cover it with grated gruyère.
Grill for 3 to 5 minutes until the gruyère is melted and bubbling.

name: Potato goulash
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot and fry the chopped onions over medium heat for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the minced garlic cloves and the tomato paste and fry for 1 minute.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the paprika so it doesn't burn.
Put the pot back on the heat, add the peeled, cubed potatoes, the caraway, the marjoram, the bay leaf and the beef stock and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the potatoes are soft and some have broken down to thicken the goulash.
Add the sliced frankfurters and heat them through for 5 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf, season with salt and pepper and serve.

name: Sweet potato and black bean chili
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot and fry the chopped onion and bell pepper over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic cloves, chili powder, cumin and paprika and fry for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the peeled sweet potatoes cut into 2 cm cubes, the canned tomatoes and the vegetable stock, then cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the drained canned black beans and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender and the chili has thickened.
Stir in the juice of the lime, season with salt and serve sprinkled with chopped coriander.

name: Niçoise salad
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes until tender, then drain and halve them.
Cook the green beans in boiling salted water for 4 minutes, then cool them in cold water.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool them in cold water, then peel and quarter them.
Whisk the olive oil with the white wine vinegar, salt and pepper.
Arrange the lettuce leaves on plates with the potatoes, green beans and tomatoes cut into wedges.
Top with the drained canned tuna, the eggs, the olives and the anchovy fillets.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and serve.
